name: Artifacts
description: Pages, documents and diagrams your bots make. Comment on any part, send feedback, and the bot revises and replies in each thread.
author: Crow

env_vars.name: CROW_ARTIFACT_ORIGIN_PORT
env_vars.description: Loopback port of this instance's artifact origin (see docs/developers/port-allocation.md). Empty: artifact viewing is off.

env_vars.name: CROW_ARTIFACT_ORIGIN_URL
env_vars.description: The origin browsers use for artifact content, on its OWN hostname (e.g. https://<artifacts-host>). Empty: the local-only fallback on this machine's loopback port, with weaker isolation.

notes: Artifacts are shown on a separate origin with no access to your Crow. Scripts in pages run sandboxed with no network; a page that tries to leave its frame is closed and flagged. Contacts' comments reach a bot only when you include them, and then only in a session limited to Artifacts.
